description: React component for rendering and managing reactions (emoji reactions) on posts in Mattermost, including UI interactions, animation handling, and accessibility features.

classes.name: Reaction
classes.description: React component class for displaying and interacting with post reactions, managing state for reaction display, handling user interactions, and accessibility features.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Reaction component state based on whether the current user has reacted and the reaction count.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates the reaction display when the reaction count changes.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles user click on the reaction button, toggling reaction state if permissions allow.

methods.name: handleAnimationEnded
methods.description: Finalizes the reaction toggle after animation, updating reaction state and calling add/remove reaction actions.

methods.name: loadMissingProfiles
methods.description: Loads user profiles for reactions that are not yet loaded.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the reaction button with emoji, count, and accessibility labels, including tooltip and animation handling.
